title: The 63 | Fyfe Golf Event
description_plain: THE 63: Across the links of the Causeway Coast This October, The 63 brings Fyfe Golf and Top100GolfCourses.com to Northern Ireland for 63 holes across four courses in two days — a journey through Castlerock and Portstewart, and two very different days of links golf on the North Coast. Day one begins at Castlerock, with nine holes on the Bann before heading back out for 18 on the Mussenden.

title: The Golfers Journal No. 36
description_plain: Everything you think you know about golf just might be wrong. Shinnecock isn't that intimidating. A major champion prefers to grind in a laid-back paradise. Features: 136 Pages, 9 × 11 inches, matte laminated and embossed cover, Smyth sewn, FSC Certified Paper.
